title: Retrieval-augmented Decoding for Improving Truthfulness in Open-ended Generation
abstract: arXiv:2508.02184v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ensuring truthfulness in large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge for reliable text generation. While supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with human feedback have shown promise, they require a substantial amount of annotated data and computational resources, limiting scalability. In contrast, decoding-time interventions offer lightweight alternatives without model retraining. However, existing decoding strategies often face issues like prompt sensitivity, limited generalization, or dependence on internal model states. We propose Retrieval-Augmented Decoding (RAD), a context-aware adaptive decoding method that leverages a compact reference grounding space built from as few as 10 annotated examples and comprising pairs of context embeddings and next-token logits from truthful responses, to enable retrieval-based logit shaping during inference. translated_title: 检索增强解码：提升开放式生成中的真实性
translated_abstract: 确保大型语言模型（LLM）的真实性仍然是实现可靠文本生成的关键挑战。虽然监督微调（SFT）和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已展现出潜力，但它们需要大量的标注数据和计算资源，限制了可扩展性。相比之下，解码时干预提供了一种无需重新训练模型的轻量级替代方案。然而，现有的解码策略往往面临提示敏感、泛化能力有限或依赖模型内部状态等问题。我们提出了检索增强解码（RAD），这是一种上下文感知的自适应解码方法，它利用一个紧凑的参考基础空间（仅需10个标注示例即可构建，其中包含来自真实响应的上下文嵌入与下一词元logits的配对数据），从而在推理过程中实现基于检索的logits塑形。在每个解码步骤，RAD检索高质量的语义……
tldr: 提出检索增强解码方法RAD，仅用10个标注示例构建参考空间，在推理时通过检索动态塑造logits分布，无需模型重训练即可显著提升开放式生成中语言模型输出的真实性。
en_tdlr: RAD (Retrieval-Augmented Decoding) builds a compact reference grounding space from as few as 10 annotated examples and adaptively shapes token logits via retrieval at each decoding step, improving truthfulness in open-ended generation without requiring model retraining or extensive annotated data.
